svg.title: The four possible outcomes of pytest.raises ValueError match Empty
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the test code at the top, then a branching diagram with four scenarios for what compute_momentum_features might do when given an empty DataFrame: raise ValueError with the word Empty in the message, raise ValueError with a different message, raise a different exception type entirely, or return normally without any exception; only the first scenario leads to a PASS verdict shown in green, the other three lead to FAIL verdicts shown in red with the specific reason for each failure annotated.
svg.text: What does the function actually do?
pytest.raises asserts BOTH the exception type AND a regex match on the message.
Both must hold. Three failure modes guard against three different bugs.
Only the leftmost scenario — exact type and matching message — produces a green test.
